name: Break Lucky Blocks Before Lasers!
desc:
Welcome to Break Lucky Blocks Before Lasers! ⚡
Use Code “welcome” in the shop

⛏️ Break Lucky Blocks before the lasers arrive!
⚡ Avoid the deadly laser grid!
🧠 Grab the Brainrots that spawn!
🏃 Bring them back to your base to earn cash!

💸 Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more money!
🏗️ Expand your base to unlock more slots!

 Like the game if you're having fun!
